Packaged backup/restore retains canonical content, assets, history, timing and recording bytes; original source survives.
OS network denial is independently verified; model-free editing/import/search and installed local-model operation work without cloud fallback.

Native keyboard, IME, clipboard and accessibility scenarios pass on this target.
Large incremental tables, properties, saved order/width, dates and calendar range edits work through actual UI.

Meeting segments and schema-aware historical value mappings restore atomically without rewinding unrelated/shared data.
Cancellation, disk-full, process interruption and declared crash/durability fault points retain a safe original or explicit incomplete state.
Backup restoration into a fresh selected destination retains original data and revokes installation-specific grants.

Factual recall, preferences, constraints, source edits/deletion, forgetting and current authority pass predefined independent expected outcomes.
Long input, useful context budgeting, cancellation and incomplete output rejection pass on the declared packs and hardware.
Representative task correctness, correction effort, latency and whole-application memory meet the predeclared rubric; fixed toy passes alone do not qualify.
Physical microphone capture, permission denial/revocation, missing/unplugged device, cancel and interrupted processing preserve recording bytes.
Declared MP3/M4A/AAC/WAV originals normalize and transcribe offline with bounded resources and useful unsupported/corrupt handling.
Authorized varied speech dataset passes the predeclared quality rubric; timing links and reviewable tasks remain correct.
Authorized representative Notion exports preserve supported page/database/schema/value/structure/link/asset behavior.
Repeated imports, partial failures, duplicate mappings and unsupported preserved evidence stay distinguishable from live native values.
Hostile documents, links, archives and resources cannot execute active content or escape scope.
Controlled recorded workloads meet the declared approximately two-second startup target; missing readiness/outliers are retained and investigated.
Representative keyword searches meet 300 ms and hybrid retrieval meets one second excluding optional reranking, with exact workload and hardware.
Realistic database including formula/rollup queries measures service plus bridge/paint and memory; accepted limits are explicitly recorded.
Recording, indexing and AI concurrency remains responsive, bounded and cancellable.
Independent clean target installation runs without developer tools or product account.
Model-free and complete explicitly acquired offline model-pack path both work.
Backup from another installation restores in a second clean installation.
Platform publisher authentication and required macOS signing/notarization validate on the distributed package.
Dependency/model redistribution and notices are reviewed for the exact application and pack bytes.
Authentic update rejects changed/wrong-publisher/downgrade packages and preserves a pre-migration recovery point.
Compatible prior app and restored snapshot perform reviewed authenticated startup handoff; interruption/failure preserves recoverability.
Uninstall preserves workspace, models and declared user settings on actual target.
All selected PRD/TRD/backlog acceptance criteria have accurate implementation and candidate/platform evidence or remain explicitly open.
Rich tabs/columns/reusable blocks, cached bookmarks and explicitly enabled sandboxed embeds pass visible editing and offline behavior.
Timeline scales/groups/dependencies, unified templates, gallery virtualization and declared formula compatibility pass native interactions.
Schedules, conditions, recurring templates, actions, missed runs and history work through visible controls; portable import stays inactive.
Rich PDF output is visually inspected with images/fonts/pagination; original and unsupported content remain preserved.
Real authorized Notion account validates source/schema/view reconstruction, property pagination/resume and nested preservation.
Actual installed paired browser extension selects a destination, retains provenance and obeys explicit permissions.
Actual native screenshot picker and consent/denial/cancellation preserve selected original image through reviewed import.
Every exposed writing/code/structured/organize mode and reviewed page/task creation passes a predeclared representative task rubric.
Generated writes remain understandable typed proposals; denied/stale/revoked/changed destinations never commit without fresh approval.
Broader memory and semantic related-content relevance, forgetting and source freshness meet the declared rubric.
Real authorized Claude discovery, supported sign-in, contained execution, streaming, cancellation, compatible resume and disconnect pass.
Real authorized Codex account/billing/model selection, contained execution, streaming, cancellation, compatible resume and disconnect pass.
OS canaries prove providers cannot read/write the workspace or bypass Trove tool/approval scopes; missing containment fails closed.
Real cross-provider handoffs, completed/interrupted turns, repeated requests and revocation preserve exact account/context/scope identities.
Actual authorized MCP clients perform scoped reads and reviewed creation against the single owning kernel.
Explicitly enabled authenticated reachable HTTPS supports actual client interoperability and reviewed operations.
Revocation, stale proposals, repeated requests, interrupted streams and server shutdown enforce permissions and deduplication.
Representative real-model image descriptions/questions and distinct OCR text pass predeclared quality rubrics, including blank/unanswerable abstention.
Original images, source links, input bounds, cancellation, offline execution and capability/quality reporting remain correct.
Real-model daily/weekly cited summaries, unresolved tasks and suggested actions pass representative expected-outcome rubrics.
Allowed proposal categories require explicit review before every write; schedules consent, deduplication, retry, freshness and inactive portable imports hold.
Deterministic reviews remain useful when generation is absent/unavailable.

Native NTFS ACLs, junction/handle/path races, no-replace publication and recovery durability pass without modifying existing access.
Actual DPAPI account isolation, lock/cancel/sign-out and original-byte preservation pass.
Windows clipboard, deep-link first/second instance, WebView prerequisites and lifecycle work offline.

Ubuntu desktop routing, permissions, clipboard, WebKitGTK/runtime and worker lifecycle work offline.
